cs.t: I went a different direction recently, i ditched the mouse and instead bought a lower-end Huion graphical tablet. I do pretty much everything with the keyboard, but while thinking about things i much prefer sketching ideas and taking notes by hand over e.g diagrams as code. It has only been a couple weeks and im still getting used to using a digital pen and what combination of software to use, but pretty happy so far with the experience.
